svg.aria-label: F07 — the detector is not a clean aquifer diagnostic
svg.desc: Two panels on deviation-factor correlation choice. On the left, three gas-in-place errors on a common position scale: matched at +12.503%, mismatched at +12.219% and consistent Hall-Yarborough at +12.543%, all three inside 0.32 percentage points of one another. On the right, three curvature t statistics on a signed axis symmetric about zero, against a critical value of plus or minus 2.0129 drawn as a shaded acceptance band: the matched water-drive case at plus 4.512, the mismatched water-drive case at plus 3.545, and a strictly volumetric history read with the wrong correlation at minus 9.046 — twice the aquifer's own magnitude, with the opposite sign. Each point carries a direct text label and its own marker shape. Full values in the data table below the figure.
